name: Airwave Style Guide
about: Where the design authority for Airwave lives — Airwave (the player), Airwave Hub and Airwave Companion — what is generated from it, and how to check it. One guide for the three apps. Read this before changing any UI or UX.

designs.owns: Where each app's look began: the owner's three hand-made designs, frozen as history (DEC-038). They are still the generators' inputs — music-player/scripts/make-shell.py writes music-player/index.html from the player's, and packages/aqua-ui/scripts/make-window-css.py writes the window stylesheets from the other two — but they are not edited: a change is a new asserted step in the generator, or a change to the product's own source.

windowStylesheets.owns: What the hub and the companion wear: the window designs’ own CSS, copied out by packages/aqua-ui/scripts/make-window-css.py (pnpm build:window-css). Generated — never edited by hand; a change to the window kit is an asserted edit in make-window-css.py (DEC-038).

windowArt.owns: AquaArt: the drawn push button, pop-up and checkbox both windows wear, published as --aq-* custom properties. One module, imported as @now-playing/aqua-ui/airwave-art.

windowKits.owns: Each window’s own kit, icons and remaining styles: the design’s markup as components, the states the designs never drew, and (hub) the contrast inks. The companion’s search-kit.tsx adds the parts its Search tool needs (a titled group, notes, the <dialog> form sheet). Per product on purpose (DEC-026).

tokens.owns: Documented values: colour, type, space, size, shadow, motion and the page skin for the component library; the `airwave` group records the Airwave window’s palette, which the design files own.

stylesheets.owns: The component library’s custom properties (light scheme on :root, dark and touch layers after it). Mirror tokens.json by hand; see tokenMap. Loaded by the player’s React source, the gallery and this guide — not by the hub or the companion.

tokenMap.owns: Which custom property carries each token, and recorded exceptions.

overrides.owns: Temporary trials written by the styleguide’s token editor, for the component library only. Empty in the repository.

components.owns: The component library: every shared React control, shell, overlay and state. Imported by the player’s React source in music-player/src (kept, not served — DEC-019), the gallery and this guide; it exports only what the player imports, and the styleguide’s usage scan lists any component no product imports so it can be removed. The hub and the companion import only the Airwave stylesheets and AquaArt from this package (DEC-026).

rules.owns: Interaction and content rules with stable IDs, their owning code and their tests.

coverage.owns: Every surface, state and journey, with discovery sources.

decisions.owns: Adopted, proposed and unresolved decisions and exceptions (DEC-###).

prose.owns: The reasoning behind the visuals, in long form.

conformance.owns: Spec §17/§18 MUSTs mapped to tests, reviewer checks or deviations.

mockups.about: The living mockups (DEC-038): one standalone file per app, rendered from the app itself by pnpm mockups:build — each screen and state as the app drew it on sample data, beside the app's own stylesheets, readable and editable by hand. They are generated: an app change must regenerate them (pnpm verify's mockups-up-to-date; pnpm styleguide:check compares each file's inputs stamp), and an owner's edit to one is carried into the app by the workflow in AGENTS.md ('Living mockups'), never the other way round.

shell.about: The served player, photographed at 1280 × 860 and 390 × 844 from pnpm build:player. shots.json records the hash of the shell they were taken from; pnpm styleguide:check fails when the shell has changed since.

imports: design/frontends/origin/airwave-now-playing.html, served as music-player/index.html: imports nothing from aqua-ui
@now-playing/aqua-ui and @now-playing/aqua-ui/now-playing.css: the React source in music-player/src, kept but not served (DEC-019)

commands.build:window-css: pnpm build:window-css — regenerates airwave-window.css and airwave-hub.css from design/frontends/origin/airwave-companion.html and airwave-hub.html, then applies the asserted edits make-window-css.py records.
commands.styleguide:build: pnpm styleguide:build — rebuilds docs/design/styleguide.html from the sources above (same as pnpm build:styleguide).
commands.styleguide:check: pnpm styleguide:check — sources and evidence exist, rule IDs are unique, every discovered screen is in the ledger, tokens.json matches the stylesheets (the library’s and the Airwave window’s), and the committed HTML was built from the current sources.
commands.styleguide:shell: pnpm styleguide:shell — after pnpm build:player, retakes the served player's screenshots for The served shell (packages/aqua-ui/styleguide/shell) and records which shell they show.
commands.styleguide:pdf: pnpm styleguide:pdf — prints the committed HTML to docs/design/styleguide.pdf with Playwright’s Chromium (set NP_STYLEGUIDE_BROWSER to use an installed Chrome or Edge).
commands.e2e: pnpm --filter @now-playing/aqua-ui test:e2e — measures every mockup at every size.
commands.mockups:build: pnpm mockups:build [player|hub|companion] — renders the living mockups in design/frontends from the apps (installed Chrome or Playwright Chromium; NP_MOCKUP_BROWSER names one).
commands.mockups:diff: pnpm mockups:diff [player|hub|companion] [--check] [--mockups <dir>] — renders the apps into a scratch folder and prints what an edited mockup changes, by section; --check exits 1 on any difference (the mockups-up-to-date gate).
commands.mockups:export: pnpm mockups:export <dir> — copies the three mockups to a folder.
commands.mockups:record-hub: pnpm build:hub && pnpm mockups:record-hub — re-records the hub answers the hub mockup is drawn with (scripts/mockups/fixtures/hub.json).

verification.note: Filled in by whoever last verified the guide at runtime. Source checks are automatic (styleguide:check); `runtime` records what was seen in a running product as it is now, and `superseded` keeps earlier records of interfaces that have since been replaced, which no longer count.

runtime.scenario: A scratch hub (pnpm build:hub, then dist/server.js on port 4564 with a fresh data folder, stopped by its PID) seeded through its API the way an administrator would: sign in with admin/admin, set a real password, two library folders with six tagged songs, two groups and an invite, an album link valid for a week, a daily backup schedule keeping 7, one backup. The admin window was signed into in Chrome and each section opened by its #id and captured (outerHTML and a 1280×900 screenshot each), and the same hub's answers to every route those sections read were recorded (packages/aqua-ui/styleguide/fixtures/hub-api.json). Seen: the sign-in in the window, the six tools, and each section with its new controls — Create Link with the playlist-or-album picker and how long it works, the backup folder, parts, schedule and Keep with Save and Revert and a Download per archive, a Scan per library folder, Network and Recommendations with Save and Revert, Discord's plain-sentence warnings with Invite the Bot withheld, and Diagnostics' log and support bundle.
runtime.method: Playwright driving installed Chrome (DOM capture and screenshots); recorded API answers
runtime.notes: Live TV from the companion (hub-live-tv) was read from the same hub's API (empty: no companion had synced) and is seen in the guide's frame, not in this window. Profiles was empty: no player was paired.

runtime.commit: renderer and helper as of 108fc3e (unchanged through e608abc); main process without 47b690d
runtime.scenario: The packaged companion (win-unpacked, built 2026-10-03 17:37) started with PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR in a scratch folder, so no person's data was read or written, attached over CDP on port 9335 and stopped by its PID. The backup schedule was set to weekly keeping 5 through the bridge; the Settings tab was opened and the Backup, Storage and privacy and About groups captured (outerHTML and screenshots), and the answers to every channel the Settings tab reads were recorded (packages/aqua-ui/styleguide/fixtures/companion-ipc.json). Seen: yt-dlp ready with Check and Update, spotDL setting itself up, FFmpeg found on the PATH; Update downloaders automatically on; the update check on; the helper on this PC only; Backup with no folder yet (Back Up Now disabled with the reason), recommendation algorithms unavailable with the reason (no hub paired), Live TV links among these settings; the cache by part, the logs, and the build with how updates are checked.
runtime.method: Playwright over CDP against the packaged app
runtime.notes: Streaming was not built into this copy (its reason was shown), so the metered-connection switches and last seen were not seen at runtime; they are covered by companion-controls.dom.test.tsx and awsp-supervisor.test.ts.

runtime.scenario: pnpm build:player, then pnpm styleguide:shell: the production build served by vite preview on port 4183 (stopped by its PID), every outside host refused, eight tagged songs added through the shell's own import path, Gantry played, Radio opened with the bundled stations, Live TV filled from a stubbed companion helper (three channels, two with a guide), and Settings opened — at 1280×860 and 390×844. The screenshots are the guide's The served shell (packages/aqua-ui/styleguide/shell).

blocked.companion: Electron-only; its renderer needs the preload bridge. Its Settings tab was seen in the packaged app on 2026-10-03 (see runtime); the other tabs are covered by its DOM and contract tests and the mockups.
blocked.android: No Android SDK or JDK 17 on the machine that built this revision.
blocked.discord: Needs a bot token and a Discord server; covered by the voice and parity tests.
blocked.local-helper: Console output was not captured for this revision; covered by its integration tests.
blocked.hub: Seen at runtime on 2026-10-03 (see runtime). Overview, Devices, Providers and Downloads were not captured in that run; they are covered by the hub's DOM, e2e, a11y and journey suites.

superseded.scenario: Player dev server, empty library, no hub: each section, Settings, search with no match, the Shared segment (toast by pointer and keyboard), and one token change (--np-accent) seen in the player and the rebuilt guide, then reverted.
superseded.method: Claude browser pane with DOM measurement
superseded.why: These are the React interface’s surfaces, served then and not now: the player serves the Airwave shell (DEC-019).
